remarks: LOCATION LOCATION LOCATION - Large tastefully updated L shaped studio located in the heart of SoNo with a view of Washington Street. This unit includes custom sound proof windows to reduce street noise and provide extra heating and cooling energy efficiency. Stylish kitchen with granite countertops and stainless appliances. Updated bathroom that includes radiant floor heating. Central air, wood floors, wood burning stove, space saving built in queen size murphy bed, laundry in unit and high ceilings with skylights provide comfortable living in SoNo. This unit is 3 Blocks to Train Station, 1/2 Block to Norwalk Harbor, Centrally located amongst Retail, Restaurants, and Movie Theatre. Don't miss out on this chic studio apartment! Covered Parking Spot in Lower Haviland Lot available for additional $80 per month.
